description: Summary figure: ACCSL conserves the PLP lysine but substitutes the catalytic substrate-binding arginine with cysteine
code:
import requests, numpy as np, re, collections
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches

# --- data recomputed above, re-stated here as literals from the executed analyses ---
rows = [  # (MdACS, dist, role, ACCS, ACCS_cons, ACCSL, ACCSL_cons)
 ('K273',1.48,'PLP Schiff base (covalent)','K323',1,'K395',1),
 ('N202',2.54,'PLP pyridine N1 region','N258',1,'N330',1),
 ('A120',2.61,'phosphate loop','G170',0,'C242',0),
 ('T121',2.64,'phosphate loop','A171',0,'C243',0),
 ("R281",2.69,"PLP 5'-phosphate",'R331',1,'R403',1),
 ('Y19',2.71,'PLP phosphate / active site','Y62',1,'S149',0),
 ('R407',2.71,'substrate alpha-carboxylate','R457',1,'C529',0),
 ('S272',2.73,'PLP','S322',1,'S394',1),
 ('S270',2.87,'PLP','A320',0,'G392',0),
 ('D230',3.12,'PLP pyridine N1 salt bridge','D286',1,'D358',1),
 ('Y233',3.15,'PLP re-face stacking','Y289',1,'Y361',1),
 ('A46',3.24,'','S104',0,'S176',0),
 ('E47',3.27,'','E105',1,'E177',1),
 ('Y145',3.37,'substrate','Y195',1,'Y267',1),
 ('G119',3.50,'phosphate loop','G169',1,'G241',1),
 ('L45',3.52,'','T103',0,'T175',0),
 ('I232',3.70,'','V288',0,'I360',1),
 ('N124',3.75,'','F174',0,'F246',0),
 ('F148',3.81,'substrate','I198',0,'F270',1),
 ('T198',3.93,'','I254',0,'I326',0),
 ('G44',4.11,'','G102',1,'G174',1),
 ('P278',4.44,'','S328',0,'S400',0)]

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(13.5, 11))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 2, height_ratios=[1.0, 1.55, 0.95], hspace=0.55, wspace=0.25)

# ---------------- Panel A: alignment windows ----------------
axA = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :]); axA.axis('off')
blocks = [
 ("PLP Schiff-base lysine (anchor motif S-K-D)",
  [('MdACS  264', 'RVHVVYSLSKDLGLPGFRV', 8),
   ('ACCS   314', 'RTHVMWATSKDFGMSGLRF', 8),
   ('ACCSL  386', 'RTHVIWGTSKDFGISGFRF', 8)], 'conserved'),
 ("Substrate alpha-carboxylate arginine (anchor motif E-P-G-W-F)",
  [('MdACS  400', 'HCTEPGWFRVCFANLPERT', 8),
   ('ACCS   450', 'ECKEPGWFRFVFSDQVHRL', 8),
   ('ACCSL  522', 'MCKEPGWFCLIFADELPRL', 8)], 'lost')]
y = 0.90
for title, lines, status in blocks:
    axA.text(0.01, y, title, fontsize=11.5, weight='bold', transform=axA.transAxes)
    y -= 0.16
    for lab, seq, hl in lines:
        axA.text(0.01, y, lab, family='monospace', fontsize=10.5, transform=axA.transAxes)
        for i, ch in enumerate(seq):
            col = '#B4232A' if (i == hl and status == 'lost' and lab.startswith('ACCSL')) else (
                  '#1A6B4A' if i == hl else '#333333')
            wt = 'bold' if i == hl else 'normal'
            axA.text(0.155 + i*0.0295, y, ch, family='monospace', fontsize=11.5,
                     color=col, weight=wt, transform=axA.transAxes)
        y -= 0.135
    y -= 0.05
axA.text(0.63, 0.80, 'K is present in all three\n(ACCSL K395 conserved)', fontsize=10, color='#1A6B4A',
         transform=axA.transAxes, va='top')
axA.text(0.63, 0.30, 'R is present in MdACS and ACCS;\nACCSL has C529 (Arg lost)', fontsize=10, color='#B4232A',
         transform=axA.transAxes, va='top')
axA.set_title('A  Pairwise alignment windows: ACCSL and ACCS against Malus domestica ACC synthase (P37821)',
              loc='left', fontsize=12, weight='bold')

# ---------------- Panel B: conservation of all 22 active-site contacts ----------------
axB = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, :])
rows_s = sorted(rows, key=lambda r: r[1])
n = len(rows_s)
ypos = np.arange(n)[::-1]
for i, r in enumerate(rows_s):
    yy = ypos[i]
    for col, (lab, cons, key) in enumerate([(r[3], r[4], 'ACCS'), (r[5], r[6], 'ACCSL')]):
        c = '#1A6B4A' if cons else '#B4232A'
        axB.add_patch(mpatches.Rectangle((col+0.55, yy-0.38), 0.9, 0.76,
                                         color=c, alpha=0.18 if cons else 0.30))
        axB.text(col+1.0, yy, lab, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=9.5, color=c,
                 weight='bold' if not cons else 'normal', family='monospace')
    axB.text(0.42, yy, r[0], ha='right', va='center', fontsize=9.5, family='monospace')
    axB.text(2.6, yy, f'{r[1]:.2f}', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8.5, color='#555555')
    axB.text(2.95, yy, r[2], ha='left', va='center', fontsize=8.5, color='#555555')
axB.set_xlim(-0.3, 7.6); axB.set_ylim(-0.9, n-0.1)
axB.set_xticks([1.0, 2.0, 2.6]); axB.set_xticklabels(['ACCS\n(Q96QU6)', 'ACCSL\n(Q4AC99)', 'dist (A)'], fontsize=10)
axB.set_yticks([]); 
for s in ('top','right','left'): axB.spines[s].set_visible(False)
axB.text(0.42, n-0.45, 'MdACS', ha='right', fontsize=10, weight='bold')
axB.set_title('B  All 22 apple ACS residues within 4.5 A of the PLP-vinylglycine adduct (PDB 1YNU), mapped by alignment\n'
              'green = identical to MdACS, red = substituted', loc='left', fontsize=12, weight='bold')

# ---------------- Panel C: ortholog distribution ----------------
axC = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
cnt = {'Arg (intact)': 76, 'Cys (lost)': 11, 'His': 1}
axC.bar(list(cnt.keys()), list(cnt.values()), color=['#1A6B4A', '#B4232A', '#888888'])
for i, (k, v) in enumerate(cnt.items()):
    axC.text(i, v+1.5, str(v), ha='center', fontsize=10)
axC.set_ylabel('ACCSL UniProt entries', fontsize=10)
axC.set_title('C  Residue at the MdACS-R407 position\nacross 88 mammalian ACCSL entries', loc='left',
              fontsize=11, weight='bold')
for s in ('top','right'): axC.spines[s].set_visible(False)

axD = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1]); axD.axis('off')
txt = ("Species carrying Cys at the R407-equivalent position\n"
       "(11 of 11 species, one entry each):\n\n"
       "  Homo sapiens, Gorilla gorilla, Macaca mulatta,\n"
       "  Theropithecus gelada, Rhinopithecus roxellana,\n"
       "  Piliocolobus tephrosceles, Callithrix jacchus,\n"
       "  Prolemur simus  (all primates)\n"
       "  Crocuta crocuta, Monodon monoceros, Orycteropus afer\n\n"
       "Species carrying Arg include Mus musculus (Q3UX83),\n"
       "Rattus norvegicus, Bos taurus, Equus caballus,\n"
       "Pan troglodytes (H2R5H2), Pongo abelii (H2NDM8).")
axD.text(0.0, 0.98, txt, fontsize=9.3, va='top', family='monospace')
axD.set_title('D  Phylogenetic distribution of the Arg loss', loc='left', fontsize=11, weight='bold')

fig.suptitle('Human ACCSL retains the PLP Schiff-base lysine but has lost the invariant substrate alpha-carboxylate arginine',
             fontsize=13.5, weight='bold', y=0.985)
plt.show()
